author: Akahdrin
quote: I feel that every version of this company's game is the same game.  Comes out and renames a few guns but the guns all still do the same thing.  You basically just pay $60 to $70 for a new map pack and a new painted on theme.  I don't feel any true innovations happening in the gameplay.  I think the only time where they tried to do something drastically different the game just flopped because the advanced warfare aspect just wasn't what people wanted.

author: Akahdrin
quote: This game is ridiculously fun.  You will find yourself dying all the time.  The two-player mode is really fun.  The only thing that's really drawing this back from being a 10, is that when the game is done you don't feel the need to go back and do it again. My only drawback is it's a one-time playthrough and there you go.

author: Akahdrin
quote: Overall I thought the game was pretty fun.  It does have a bit of a Time sink to be able to do things but the racing is enjoyable.  I don't think this game is a 10 but it is definitely a solid eight.

author: Akahdrin
quote:
I won't rate this a 1 or a 0, it is better than that.  This isn't a review bomb.

This is wishing they would have focused on optimization and performance over eye candy.  Yes the game is beautiful, but it does not run well at all.

Some of the attention to detail is fantastic and some is less than GTA V.  The gameplay loop is still steal a car do emission evade the cops and shoot people.  Not really much has changed at all it's just prettier.  I don't feel that my $80 was worth it.  I'm not sure what justified the 33% price hike or even 66% if you got the ultimate edition.

I know that a lot of people will love this game.  It just want to include me for likely a while.

I will likely revisit the review when it comes out for PC.  I put in a fast 10 hours, but I don't want to put it anymore.  I hope everyone who brought it and enjoys it continues too, this game is just not for me.

author: Akahdrin
quote:
I actually own the game.  This review isn't made to counter anything or to hope that this game wins game of the year.  This game is a masterpiece of another masterpiece.

The things that the game did right did right in spades.  I redid the soundtrack with the symphony, the graphical updates are absolutely beautiful, even though the game is limited in size it still feels massive, the combat is still easy for any age, the puzzles aren't so frustrating that it makes you want to throw your controller against the wall, and the game is overall engaging for a broad audience. 

This game wasn't made for any other reason than to get Ocarina of Time out to more people again.  And for that it's succeeded.  This isn't about what is the game of the year, or if you bombing one game or the other, this is just a review about Ocarina of Time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Akahdrin
quote:
I am pretty convinced that people exepect every game to be flawless or it can't be fun.

The gameplay is fun.  My 9 year old son loves it to pieces.  I enjoy playing it as a 41 year old man.

Combat isn't overly hard, exploration is enoyable, the story is simple yet cute.  The 0 star reviews do not know what a zero star game is.

author: Akahdrin
quote: Easily my favorite game on the Switch.  I didn't think anything would touch Zelda and boy was I wrong.  The replay value is insane.  The fun in your living room with your friends is priceless.  The controls are perfect.  The 60 fps and 1080p graphics in docked mode is exactly what I was hoping for.  What's the only thing I would want changed?  I guess just to turn off auto-steering by default.

author: Akahdrin
quote:
Easily the best game that I've ever played on a console.  I am shocked at the amount of negative spite reviews that rated it a 1.  I would rate the game E.T. for Atari a 1, not this.  Why is this game so good?

It's open world, but not just open world.  Like the Witcher 3 was pretty open, but I honestly don't care about Geralt.  Fallout has the same problem, the main character is simply not important.  Link is iconic and we know who he is.  There aren't many games that simply pull you in based purely off the characters, but Nintendo happens to own the best IPs in the business.

I hope that Metacritic does away with spite votes.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
